name: Greek Roast Lamb with Lemon Potatoes

ingredients.name: desiree potatoes
ingredients.original: 1.2 kg desiree potatoes, cut into wedges

steps: Heat the oven to 160C. Cut a dozen small slits in the lamb and push a piece of garlic into each.
Rub the lamb with half the lemon juice, half the oregano, half the oil, salt and plenty of pepper.
Toss the potato wedges with the remaining lemon juice, oregano and oil and spread them in a large roasting tin. Sit the lamb on top and pour the stock around.
Roast for 3 hours, basting the potatoes with the pan juices every 45 minutes, until the lamb pulls away from the bone.
Raise the heat to 220C for a final 20 minutes to crisp the potatoes and colour the lamb.
Rest the lamb for 20 minutes under foil before pulling it into chunks and serving with the potatoes and pan juices.
